Past analyses of AAPL (most recent first):

[2026-09-14 | AAPL | Overweight | +1.8% | -0.1% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Overweight

**Executive Summary**: Overweight AAPL, staged and constructive rather than a chase. Tranche 1 is smaller than the trader proposed: ~20–25% of the intended overweight at market ≈ $333.08 (roughly 1.03–1.04x standard weight), because %B ≈ 0.97 into the $334.02 band offers only ~0.94% to $336.22 against 5.33% to the $315.34 stop. Tranche 2 (~35–40%) releases on a daily close above $336.22 (half credit 40–50M shares, full above 50M) or a pullback into the $318–$324 confluence (50 SMA 318.46 / Bollinger mid 317.98 / 10 EMA 324.05), whichever prints first; tranche 3 (~30%) waits for Q4 FY2026 gross margin near 50% on double-digit revenue growth. Cap total notional so a 10% adverse gap costs ≤1.0–1.2% of portfolio value (≈10–12% of portfolio value at most), reaching full 1.15x standard only after the cheaper tranches fill. A close below $324.05 pauses all adds; a close below $318–$321 on above-average volume, or below $315.34, cuts tactical tranches back to benchmark 1.0x; trim tactical layers only at $340.08 then $344.57. Horizon 1–3 months, re-underwritten at the Q4 FY2026 print.

**Investment Thesis**: Direction is settled by the earnings engine and the trend stack; only entry geometry and size are contested — hence Overweight, not Buy and not Hold.

The aggressive analyst wins the fundamental and structural debate largely unopposed. Q3 FY2026 revenue +16.4% to $109.4B, gross margin 50.06% versus 46.49% (+357 bps), incremental gross margin 71.9%, operating income +26.6%, diluted EPS +28.7%, with the FY2026 sequence improving every quarter (+18.3% → +21.8% → +28.7%). Nine-month operating cash flow of $117.0B already exceeds all of FY2025's $111.5B; FCF of $110.2B converts at 108.6% of net income; net cash of $62.2B is up 84% y/y after $73.9B of returns; the dividend consumes ~12% of TTM earnings. The tape corroborates: $333.08 > 10 EMA $324.05 > 50 SMA $318.46 > 200 SMA $285.24, 50 SMA re-accelerating ~$0.53/day, higher lows $300.57 vs $273.75, VWMA $321.20 rising from $307.76 with price 3.7% above it, MACD 3.934 over a 2.309 signal with five expanding histogram sessions. His valuation arithmetic is also correct: the stale $8.72 TTM EPS gives ~38x, but the 9M annualized $9.17 base gives ~36.3x, and 100 bps of gross margin ≈ $3.6B pre-tax ≈ $0.21 EPS, so even a full reversion to 48% leaves margins far above last year's 46.49%.

The conservative analyst wins the entry-and-risk arithmetic. At $333.08 the payoff is ~+0.94% to $336.22 versus −2.71% to the 10 EMA, −4.39% to the 50 SMA/Bollinger confluence and −5.33% to the $315.34 stop; the 9/14 candle opened $334.79, printed $335.50 and closed below the open at $333.08 on 39.3M shares versus ~43.1M average, $0.94 under the upper band. Three single-day drops worse than 5% in twelve months (−5.00%, −6.12%, −7.35%) mean a stop 5.33% away with ATR $7.77 is a level, not an exit. The quality caveats were not refuted: inventory +94% with raw materials +260%, intangibles +91%, R&D +32.5% against 16.4% revenue growth, tax rate 17.58% from 15.39%, and ~$10.8B of the OCF gain from lower cash taxes (normalized nearer +30%); RSI 63.32 versus 71.65 at the same price is a genuine momentum divergence.

Where the conservative loses is remedy. Requiring no capital until either a $318–$324 pullback or a high-volume close above $336.22 followed by a successful retest is the exact failure this desk has already paid for — the 09-04 reflection states that when direction is settled and invalidation sits below spot, the initial tranche should go on at market or on a time stop rather than wait on an unprinted confluence, and the 09-03 and 08-25 reflections flag single volume gates as over-insurance. With consolidation between 324 and 336 the base case, that plan can never trigger and leaves a caller underweight a repaired uptrend. His automatic trim below $324.05 is also too tight with ATR $7.77 and the confluence immediately beneath.

Where the aggressive loses is size and optionality. "Coil" is one reading of a stall, not the reading; bulls must print a high-volume close above $336.22 and have not. His 35% market tranche pays full size into inverted spot reward/risk. And the foldable Duo, the Ternus transition and the Sonera deal carry no pricing, unit, ship-date, term or close-date data — optionality, not earnings, and not a basis for capital.

The neutral construction therefore governs and is adopted: tranche 1 at ~20–25% of the intended overweight at market, so exposure is live through a possible 324–336 consolidation without paying full size at %B 0.97; tranche 2 (~35–40%) as the main commitment on the breakout or the confluence, whichever comes first; tranche 3 (~30%) behind the Q4 gates; total notional capped so a 10% gap costs ≤1.0–1.2% of portfolio value (≈10–12% of portfolio value); and a pause-not-trim rule below $324.05, with trimming reserved for a close below $318–$321 on above-average volume or below $315.34. One amendment from prior outcomes: half of tranche 2 credits on a close above $336.22 on 40–50M shares, full above 50M, so the breakout branch is realistically reachable. Buy is rejected because the first tranche would pay full size into the upper band at 36–38x on unproven margin durability; Hold is rejected because withholding new money from 28.7% EPS growth with expanding margins and a repaired uptrend would over-weight the weaker side of this debate.

What would change it: upgrade toward Buy if Q4 guidance shows gross margin ≥49–50% on revenue growth ≥12% and the breakout above $336.22 comes on >50M shares. Downgrade toward Hold/Underweight if gross margin falls below 48% without a one-time explanation, finished goods inventory rises, buybacks keep decelerating from −12% y/y without a stated reason, price closes below $315.34, or the UK collective action or BASF suit produces a quantified liability. No incremental capital is allocated on the Duo, Ternus or Sonera headlines alone.

Stated gaps: no Q4 guidance, no FY2027 consensus, no Duo unit economics or Sonera terms, no segment/geography/unit disclosure, no options chain or implied volatility (so no hedge can be priced and all targets are technical), no sentiment or insider data, a news sample of 20 of 200 records all dated 2026-09-13 with nothing from Sep 7–12, and no portfolio context — all sizing is expressed as a fraction of the caller's own standard AAPL allocation and must respect their single-name limits.

**Price Target**: 344.57

**Time Horizon**: 1–3 months, re-underwritten at the Q4 FY2026 print (late October)

REFLECTION:
The +1.8% raw return with -0.1% alpha vs SPY shows the direction was right in absolute terms but produced no market-relative edge, and five days is far too short to judge a 1–3 month Overweight thesis. It supports the repaired-uptrend/constructive part of the call but undercuts paying above-benchmark size at %B≈0.97 into the $334–$336 band, since the added exposure merely tracked SPY. Next time, separate absolute direction from relative alpha explicitly and require either cheaper entry geometry or a clear catalyst before sizing above benchmark.

[2026-09-11 | AAPL | Hold | +1.2% | +1.3% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Hold

**Executive Summary**: Hold AAPL at current standard weight — do not trim into this tape and do not add at 332.27. Keep roughly 90–100 units per 100 of the caller's standard AAPL allocation rather than executing the 25–50 unit reduction the risk seats proposed, because this desk's own 08-28 and 09-03 falsification/upgrade gates (close above 322.37 on >47M, then above 330.81 on >50M) have both now fired: 332.27 on 50.7M shares, with 70.0M (1.65x average) on the 9/10 thrust. No new money at spot — reward to first supply at 333.43–336.91 is ~1.2% against ~3.6% to the 320.20 tactical trail and ~5.1% to the 315.30 core stop. Trail tactical exposure at 320.20, core at 315.30, hard invalidation on a close below 309.90; size so a repeat of the −8.6% 7/31 gap (333.43→304.81 on 132.5M shares) is survivable without forced action, and hedge ahead of the late-October FQ4 print if tools are available. Horizon 1–3 months.

**Investment Thesis**: WHAT THE BEARS WON: the near-term arithmetic at 332.27 is genuinely poor for fresh money — ~1.2% to the 333.43–336.91 July-gap supply shelf versus ~3.6% to the 320.20 tactical stop, AAPL 0.12% above the upper Bollinger band at 331.86, 9/11 closing only 60% up the day's range and four points under the 336.22 high, a lower RSI high (62.79 vs 63.38) and a lower MACD histogram peak (+1.325 vs +2.028 on 9/3). The conservative analyst's strongest point stands unanswered: 320.20 and 315.30 are not gap protection, because this name opened −8.6% from 333.43 to 304.81 on 132.5M shares on 7/31 and drew down 12.77% to 300.57 by 8/12. The forensics are legitimate watch items — inventory +94% with raw materials +260% and days 9→16, the $12.1B intangible increase against only ~$1.8B visible cash outflow paired with a $13.5B rise in other noncurrent liabilities, ~36x derived FY26E earnings at a ~3% FCF yield, and macro pressure as the S&P 500 undercuts its 50-day into CPI and Fed-hike positioning.

WHY THAT DOES NOT CARRY TO A TRIM: every one of those arguments is about entry price, and all three seats imported it into a decision about ownership without justifying the translation. The trend is stacked and accelerating, not deteriorating: 332.27 > 10 EMA 322.05 > VWMA 319.82 > 50 SMA 317.97 > 200 SMA 284.95, MACD line 3.227 (highest since 7/31), histogram re-expanding to +1.325 after troughing at +0.426 on 9/9. The "divergence" is a sub-one-point RSI difference six sessions apart — timing noise, not reversal. Volume confirms rather than contradicts: 70.0M on the 9/10 advance versus 39.6M and 35.5M on the 9/4 and 9/8 declines. Fundamentals are accelerating, not fading: nine-month revenue +16.2%, Q3 gross margin 50.06%, EPS +22.4% with growth stepping 18.3% → 21.8% → 28.7%, $110.2B nine-month FCF, $62.2B net cash, zero new long-term issuance.

THE DECISIVE EVIDENCE is this desk's own record and its own triggers. The 08-28 Underweight was invalidated by a close above 322.37 on >47M shares, and the 09-03 Hold's stated upgrade condition — a close above 330.81 with half size credited at 40–50M and full size above 50M — is now met at 332.27 on 50.7M. Against that, the trim record is unambiguous: 07-13, 07-20–07-24, 08-11–08-13, 08-17, 08-21, 08-24, 08-27, 08-28 and 09-02 each forfeited roughly 1.5–5.5% of five-day alpha, while the 08-26 Overweight earned +3.8% and the 09-03 Hold +2.4%. The 09-03 reflection named the exact error to avoid: letting a single volume gate or a pullback-limit plan mechanically block participation in a confirmed uptrend. Cutting 25–50 units one day after the confirmation the plan itself demanded is that error relabelled.

WHERE EACH SEAT OVERREACHED: the aggressive analyst is right that a full exit abandons a 16% grower, but his barbell is internally inconsistent — extended into resistance, yet pre-committed to a 316–320 re-risk with no proof of stabilization. The conservative analyst is right on stop geometry and gap risk but converts it into a 35–50 unit cut plus a "no re-risk until 60M or a flush" posture, precisely the over-strict confirmation stack that has cost this desk alpha three times. The neutral analyst's 30–40 units is the most defensible of the three but still rests on the same ~1:1 near-term R:R, which speaks to buying, not holding. Their unanimity reflects shared inputs, not independent corroboration.

WHAT WOULD CHANGE IT: downgrade toward Underweight on a close below 326.30 after a failed retest of 333.43–336.91 without volume, or on two consecutive closes below 320.20; move to Sell on a close below 315.30 then 309.90, FQ4 gross margin below 48%, inventory days above ~20 without matching revenue, or disclosed impairment/amortization against the $12.1B intangible. Upgrade toward Overweight on a 316–322 pullback that actually stabilizes (two sessions holding 316.63, or a reclaim of 326.30), or a decisive close above 336.91 then 344.57 on ≥42.5M shares with a successful retest, confirmed by FQ4 gross margin ≥49.5% with inventory flat-to-down and the intangible reconciled. Trim into 336–340 only on a second rejection there on declining volume.

STATED GAPS: no portfolio context, so all sizing is a fraction of the caller's own standard AAPL weight subject to their single-name and mega-cap caps; no options chain or implied-vol data, so an October collar cannot be priced and event risk must be managed through gross exposure; no segment, product, geographic, unit or ASP data, so 50.06% margin durability is unattributable on both sides; no consensus forward EPS to verify ~36x; the cause of the 7/31 −8.6% gap remains unestablished; sentiment data is unavailable and treated as a gap, not a benign signal.

**Price Target**: 344.0

**Time Horizon**: 1–3 months, re-underwritten at the late-October FQ4 FY2026 print

REFLECTION:
The +1.3% five-day alpha (raw +1.2%) supports the Hold/no-trim directional call, though five days is far too short to validate a 1–3 month thesis. It supports the thesis’s core claim that the 332.27 close on 50.7M and the 70.0M thrust confirmed an accelerating uptrend, while it does not test the bear entry-price/R:R concern because no pullback to 320.20 or 315.30 occurred. The lesson for the next similar analysis is to treat the desk’s own pre-committed confirmation gates as binding and require a failed retest or stop breach before trimming into strength, rather than relabeling entry-price discomfort as ownership risk.

[2026-09-10 | AAPL | Overweight | +3.2% | +2.6% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Overweight

**Executive Summary**: Overweight AAPL — own it, do not chase it at 326.57. Treat a standard AAPL allocation as 100 units: hold a 75–80 unit core, add 12–15 units only on a stabilized test of the 315.28–317.99 50-SMA/VWMA cluster (first add 317.50, stop 309.50, ~$8/share or ~1 ATR of risk), and add 10–12 units only on a daily close above 330.81 with volume at or above the 70M-share pace (stop 315.28, ~$15.72 or ~2 ATRs), reserving 3–5 units for a hold above 329.42 or a push through 333.43 to reach the 110–115 unit Overweight target. Risk controls: a close below 315.28 trims 25% of tactical adds, a close below 309.50 cuts the adds and returns the core to neutral pending reassessment, and 344.57 is a trim-into-strength level (20–25% if momentum weakens). If flat and the mandate requires exposure, start 15–20 units rather than 30–40, and if it does not, wait for either trigger or for the PPI/CPI prints to clear rather than paying up into event risk.

**Investment Thesis**: DIRECTION IS SETTLED; ENTRY GEOMETRY IS NOT — and that is what fixes the rating at Overweight rather than Buy.

What the aggressive seat won, and no one rebutted with numbers: the operating record and the trend. Nine-month FY26 revenue +16.2%, gross profit and operating income +21.7%, net income +20.0%, diluted EPS +22.4% to $6.88, Q3 revenue +16.4% at 50.06% gross margin with operating income +26.6% and EPS +28.7%, $110.2B of nine-month FCF, $146.5B cash/securities and $62.2B net cash. Structure corroborates: 326.57 sits above the 50-SMA (317.22), above the VWMA (317.99), ~14.7% above a rising 200-SMA (284.65) with the 50/200 spread widening, MACD positive at 2.36 over a 1.57 signal (+0.79 histogram), RSI 58.94 with room, and the 2026-09-09 higher low at 309.90 held above the July low of 300.00. No confirmed breakdown exists. That is a franchise and a primary trend you want to be long, and it is why neither Hold nor Underweight survives: this desk's own AAPL record — Underweights on 07-13, 07-20–07-24, 08-12, 08-13, 08-17, 08-20, 08-21, 08-24, 08-27 and 09-02 — repeatedly forfeited 1.6–5.5% of five-day alpha by trimming or under-owning inside an intact uptrend, while the 08-26 Overweight earned +3.8%. The 09-02 reflection said it plainly: require a confirmed lower close before treating resistance-without-volume as a sell trigger. There is no confirmed lower close here.

What the conservative and neutral seats won, and why it is not Buy: entry geometry, and the price of the unknown. At 326.57 the stock is pressed into a three-way confluence — Bollinger upper band 329.42, gap-zone top ~329.59, 2026-09-03 high 330.81 — where a breakout already failed to close above the gap edge. Upside to the gate is ~1.3% against ~5.1% to the 309.90 low; with ATR 7.90 (2.42% of price) that is not a trade, it is a coin flip with a bad payoff. The aggressive seat's rebuttal — that 330.81 is a gate, not the destination, with 333.43 then 344.57 beyond it — is directionally right but is a post-confirmation argument; it cannot be underwritten before the gate opens.
